column2: [intro]
I'm a singer full of humor,
I leave controversy in its corner,
My goal is to make you laugh and dance,
Let's forget our troubles, take a chance.
Controversy isn't my vibe,
In music, I find the harmony,
I prefer jokes and smiles wide,
Come to my world, where joy is free.
I sing to bring forward happiness,
Laughing together, such a charming mess,
Critics, I leave them aside,
People come to see me, to enjoy the ride.
Controversy isn't my thing,
I want my crowd to jump and sing,
We won't take life too seriously,
Lightheartedness is my creed, it's key.
[ solo ]
Controversy isn't my vibe,
In music, I find the harmony,
I prefer jokes and smiles wide,
Come to my world, where joy is free.
[ outro ]
